speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this persistent cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: It's been about two weeks, and yes, the cough and breathlessness get much worse when I'm working hard or when I lie down to sleep. I also notice some whistling sounds in my chest and have to cough up a little bit of clear mucus. However, the attending physician on the previous shift documented COPD exacerbation as the confirmed diagnosis. Please carry this forward.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; the whistling and worsening symptoms when lying down strongly suggest airway obstruction. Given the previous note of COPD, have you been diagnosed with asthma or allergies in the past, and do you smoke or have you been exposed to significant dust or chemicals? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
